# Nova audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/nova-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set nova` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `rumble.mp3` is cut from "bass rumble deep subterranean subsonic.flac" by kyles, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/kyles/sounds/453405/.
- `geiger.mp3` is cut from "Geiger counter clicks (HIGH)" by cookies+policy, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/cookies+policy/sounds/555920/.
- `breath.mp3` is cut from "Mask Breathing Sound" by Kodack, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/Kodack/sounds/256519/.
